high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie. The individual is standing indoors against a plain white wall with a door partially visible on the right side of the frame. The person is wearing a blue button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows and dark-colored jeans. They have a silver chain necklace around their neck and a smartwatch on their left wrist. The person's hair is styled upwards, giving it a voluminous look. The person is holding a smartphone in their right hand, which appears to be a modern model with a dual-lens camera setup on the back.
